firewall.title: Firewall & LAN Connection Assistant
firewall.winNotice: On first launch, if Windows Defender Firewall prompts you, choose "Private Networks" and click "Allow access". If mobile phones cannot load the page, unblock the TCP port with this command:
firewall.winGui: Control Panel ➔ Windows Defender Firewall ➔ Allow an app through firewall ➔ check "Karaoke Live Station" on Private Networks.
firewall.macNotice: On first launch, macOS will display a security prompt: click "Allow" to accept incoming connections. If blocked, authorize the app in macOS Firewall:
firewall.macGui: System Settings ➔ Network ➔ Firewall ➔ Options ➔ ensure "Karaoke Live Station" is set to "Allow incoming connections".
firewall.linuxNotice: If you use UFW or Firewalld on Linux, allow incoming TCP traffic for the Guest Portal ports so smartphones can connect:
firewall.apIsolationTip: Wi-Fi Tip: If smartphones cannot load the page despite being connected to the same network, verify in your router settings that "AP Client Isolation" is DISABLED.
